page.overview:
Who is Fourtricks?

Fourtricks is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates.

Due to the nature of his SMILE transformation, much of Fourtricks' body is transformed into a large rooster, although his head is at the chicken's rear end. He wears sunglasses over his eyes and has pronounced lips, and his hair is a massive pompadour resembling a chicken's tail. He has a tattoo of the number 4 on both his left cheek and on the left side of his chicken's head, as well as a tattoo of the word "Tricks" on his forehead over his left eye. He has normal arms stretching down from the top of the chicken's backside, but his legs seem to have transformed into those of a chicken.

Fourtricks is very confident in his abilities, expressing disapproval at the loud fear of his subordinates and saying that truly strong fighters stay quiet.

As a Shinuchi, Fourtricks has authority over the lower-ranking members of the Beasts Pirates. Despite his great confidence in his abilities, he was easily defeated by one kick from Sanji.
